To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) an application-driven, communication architecture specification is essential in the design exploration process of multiprocessor-based SoC systems, and (ii) the proposed prototyping platform, which incorporates this specification, is a useful and efficient tool in this exploration process.

we have developed a communication architecture specification and a modular modeling and execution environment that allows us to simulate the application-level behavior of the system, and that through these simulation studies we can obtain the necessary information to make informed design decisions regarding the communication sub-system of the system-on-chip.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and application of a retargetable simulation platform which facilitates the design exploration of communication architectures for multiprocessor-based SoCs.
the application-driven design space exploration of the communication architecture in a multiprocessing SoC.
the design of an integrated design methodology for the communication architecture of multiprocessor SoCs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this methodology provides a framework for the early exploration of the communication architecture in the context of the entire application.
this environment provides the designer a powerful tool to evaluate the impact of communication architecture choices in the overall system performance and cost.
the proposed platform is a powerful tool for the early design space exploration of the communication architectures for multiprocessor-based embedded systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed environment provides a flexible, efficient and accurate simulation environment for the communication architectures in embedded systems.
we provide a communication architecture modeling and simulation platform for application-driven design exploration and optimization.
we have provided a methodology for communication architecture design and evaluation that is application-driven, retargetable, and executable.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the communication architecture can now be designed with the same level of confidence as the computation architecture.
the communication architecture specification is an important design parameter that must be considered in a holistic design exploration environment.

by using the communication architecture specification in conjunction with the application-driven retargeted prototyping platform, the designer can quickly and efficiently explore the communication sub-system and obtain the information necessary to make the design decisions.
